title: [GMCP 203.007.M] Mastery: Transport adapter SPI and embedded/in-process operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-007-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: A stable transport SPI admits in-process, Unix-domain socket, named-pipe, WebSocket or future transports without changing protocol semantics. A common conformance harness proves ordering, cancellation, limits, identity propagation, observability, shutdown, and error equivalence across adapters, while experimental transports are capability-negotiated and never silently presented as standard MCP. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
limitations: Core serves the server role only on the byte-pipe transport SPI (in-process ChannelConnection, Unix-domain socket Transport where #[cfg(unix)], stdio, and Streamable HTTP); the client transport role, Windows named pipes, and WebSocket have no adapter in core and are not claimed.

Windows x86_64 exercises the in-process and shipped stdio adapters plus direct/HTTP envelope gates; Unix-domain socket parity is gated behind #[cfg(unix)], and process RSS statm budgets run on Linux targets.

No new transport crate or network protocol wrapper was added; mastery proves production-path parity across existing transport adapters and requires clean committed evidence in .agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-007.jsonl.

reuse.reason: The transport adapter SPI (crates/susi-gmcp/src/server.rs, ChannelConnection, serve_channel_connection, GmcpServer::run_stdio, StdioGate, BoundedLines) and conformance harness (adapter_runtime, embedded_adapter, socket_adapter, transport_adapter_script, transport_adapter_attacks, adapter_fixture_replay, adapter_property_run, ledger_report, ledger_tool_report, evidence helpers) already exist in Susi Core and tests/gmcp_requirements.rs; this mastery gate composes and verifies them end-to-end without duplicating adapter logic.
